title: Mixed Event — In This Singing City — Episode6 In That Strength

meta.Event Outline: With days to go before Leo/need's solo show, Shiho is on Vivid Street for an errand. When a powerful voice coming from an alley blows her away, she follows the sound to find An alone, singing intensely.

rows.Line: Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I'm glad I got to talk to Shinonome yesterday. I want to do the same...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I want to take music seriously. Even more than I do already...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(Shiho sounds really good again... I'm getting super excited!
It's like her feelings are being carried by the music!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Shiho really is amazing. She just keeps getting better and better...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (We need to try and keep up...!)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I can count on everyone's performances.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Even if I push forward, Ichika and the others will always end up beside me.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (In that case, I've gotta make sure they can follow me further than we've ever gone...!)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We were really good just now! Ichika was so cool during the chorus...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks. Shiho was producing a really incredible sound, so I guess I...followed her.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, I get what you mean! She had me going all out to get on her level!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's just what I thought, then. I knew you guys felt that way based on how you were playing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well then, let's ride this wave and go one more time.

rows.Speaker: Saki, Honami & Ichika
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Nice work, guys.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
We really went for it today! Hey, do you guys wanna stop at the cafe for a while?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sounds good. I'd like that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I can't, sorry. I need to go collect the amp I took in for repairs.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh... Yes, it was due for collection today, wasn't it?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: In that case, how about the three of us go today?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Right. I'll join you guys another time.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then, we'll make sure to thoroughly check the menu for anything new you might like!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sure thing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright then. I guess I'll get going.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh yeah.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (If I'm going there anyway, I can let Miku know.)
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Thanks for bringing me along again, Shiho.>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Don't mention it. I was coming here anyway for my amp.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And you seemed to really like this street.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yeah. It really is an interesting place.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <With so many people performing, it's as if the city itself is singing their love of music.>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I agree. Though, this area is a little out of the way, and I don't see anyone performing.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, but I can hear someone singing over there.>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh yeah. But, that voice...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It is her...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <The way she's singing is totally different from when we heard her at Weekend Garage.>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She's singing with so much force it's heart-rending... Just like when I heard her the other night on this street.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Heart-rending...?
I see what you mean. She's putting her heart and soul into it.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <It sort of reminds me of Ichika and the others during those intense training sessions.>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We all know that it isn't going to be easy.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Even so...
I want to make that happen before our show.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <It's as if Shiraishi is trying to catch up to someone with her singing, like the others tried to catch up to you.>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh... Yeah, you're right.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Shiraishi is just like the others were that time.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Even today... They performed with so much intensity.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Shiraishi has something just like the strength I felt that time...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huff... Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Time for a quick break, I think.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Where's my drink...? Oh, I'm all out.
I better go buy something.
Do you want this?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, Hinomori? What brings you here?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I had an errand at an instrument shop around here, and now I'm on my way home.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I haven't opened this yet, so please take it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I bought it, but never got around to drinking it. Call it my treat.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hahaha. Well then, don't mind if I do.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Back to life! Thanks, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm glad to hear it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Your singing was amazing just now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm not sure how to put it... You just sang really well, with so much feeling.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hahaha... Really? I mean, I wouldn't say it was that good...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, I mean it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I remembered the others when I heard you sing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh... As in, Ichika and everyone?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. I'm not sure how to put it, but your singing...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Your singing was so powerful. Like the feeling of desperately wanting to be around someone. Like thinking about someone dear to you and...following them...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Uh... Sorry for suddenly rambling on like that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's fine. But what made you think that?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, uh... It's my band, you see.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The thing is, I'm the most experienced member.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, I didn't realize. But now that you mention it, I did think your bass playing was really advanced when I saw you guys perform.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
*Nod*
And until recently, I was holding myself back to match the others' level...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But lately, something has changed with them...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The others told me to stop holding back, and that they'll catch up to my level eventually. After that, I took a good look at myself and started to play with all I have.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: At the time, they all had this really intense look in their eyes.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And when you were singing just now, you had a look just like that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wow, you hit the nail on the head.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm also...
